name: smwblocks-boost-block-up-regardless-of-holding-jump
title: boost block up regardless of holding jump
description:
Unlike other boost blocks hosted on smwc (not really, mainly made by blockreator), this block will cause the controller to automatically hold or disable the jump button as he flung up, making it so he always launch up at the same height.

requires Uberasm.
